Author: hiarc
Name: Ostinato
Description: Swaps the pressed action for the next step of your rotation, using per-job rules you can switch on and off.
TestingChangelog:
Test build for PR #25: Exception policy cleanup, zero-sum follow-ups, chip wrap, row scroll

1. If saving your settings fails, Ostinato no longer retries on a timer. It tries again at your next settings change or when the plugin unloads.
2. Long "used by" lists on the Knobs tab now wrap onto more lines instead of running off the edge of the window.
3. When the window is too narrow for the job buttons or the tab row, that row scrolls sideways on its own instead of running off the window.

Minor: internal cleanup only. Every exception handler in the plugin is now listed and checked by a test, and eight are removed.
